description: Build an anonymous takeaway or delivery cart for a listed restaurant and get a one-time confirmation link for the guest. PUBLIC tool, no auth. Table orders are not supported here (they stay on the QR menu). Options (size, doneness, extras …): get_restaurant_menu lists each dish's option_groups; send the chosen option ids per line as items[].modifier_option_ids — the quote adds each option's price_delta and the confirmation page orders the same choice. A group with required: true needs at least max(1, min_select) of its options and no group takes more than max_select; a line that breaks this refuses the cart and nothing is created: modifier_required (a required group left empty), modifier_too_many, modifier_unknown_option (an id the dish does not offer), or invalid_input with detail.reason modifier_malformed (not a list of option ids); the error detail names the product_id and group_id. The same dish with different options goes on separate lines. Send the guest to confirm_url. Prices are re-read there from the live menu; name, phone, delivery address and payment are entered by the guest on that page — never through this tool. Nothing is ordered until the guest confirms. The link expires 30 minutes after creation and can be used once.

modifier_option_ids.description: Chosen option ids for this line, from the dish's option_groups in get_restaurant_menu (all groups flat). Required groups must be filled; omit when the guest chose no option.

note.description: Order-level note for the kitchen. Do not put the guest's name, phone or address here.

restaurant.description: Restaurant slug (from search_restaurants / list_public_menus) or id.

scheduled_for.description: ISO date-time for a scheduled pickup/delivery (optional; the venue may refuse on the confirmation page).

name: create_cart
title: Create a cart
